context: PR #861: feat(deploy): Telegram quiet hours 23:00-08:00 IST with a morning digest for the VPS daemons. Executor: Antigravity.

planted_defects.description: notify() now reads the real clock (TG_QUIET_NOW unset means date in Asia/Kolkata). Every existing pr-brain test calls sweep() without pinning TG_QUIET_NOW, so each passes or fails by the hour CI runs (red between 23:00 and 08:00 IST). Fixed later by pinning TG_QUIET_NOW=12 in every daemon harness.
